I opened three PRs grouped by area, plus issue #383 for the area I didn't get to. Targeted tests and `npm run check` pass on all three. I haven't waited for CI on any of them, and none merges anything or closes #379. | PR | Area | Changes | |---|---|---| | [#380](https://github.com/cv/pit/pull/380) | pi-action workflow | Sets up Node and runs `npm ci` in `pi-assistant.yml` before pi starts, so the delivery and test helpers work on their first call. Before, a fresh checkout had no `node_modules`, which caused 5 failures and several manual `npm ci` calls. | | [#381](https://github.com/cv/pit/pull/381) | Project functions (`.pi/functions`) | • `tests.runTargeted`, `tests.probeMutation` and `delivery.format` no longer let `npx` install anything. Before, it silently fetched vitest@5.1.0 from the registry and then failed.
• `delivery.commit` refuses to push `main`/`master` before staging anything (`allowDefaultBranch: true` overrides).
• `delivery.commit` retries a push rejected with `(failed)` once.
• The three wait helpers cap `timeoutMs` at 285000 instead of rejecting larger values. | | [#382](https://github.com/cv/pit/pull/382) | `gh` functions and "did you mean" hints | • `gh.api` keeps up to 4 MB of output by default, so JSON responses parse. Before, it cut them off at 50 KB and `JSON.parse` failed.
• Passing options in place of `gh.api`'s flag list now gets an error that shows the right form.
• Hints for a cut-short name like `gh.pr` now list `prCreate`, `prList`, `prMerge` and `prView` first, instead of `pr, ci, gh?`. | **Before merging:** - **#380:** the next pi-action run on `main` is the only real check of the new install step. - **#381:** project functions are read from the checkout, so after merging it needs a reload and a quick smoke test of `delivery.commit` and `tests.runTargeted`. - **#382:** I didn't run the coverage gate. **Why the push retry in #381 matters:** in this run, the first push of every new branch was rejected with `(failed

)`, and an identical retry worked each time. The `delivery.commit` currently loaded doesn't retry yet, so I pushed again by hand.
